candidate_merges.message: Preserve multiline quoted values in Docker Compose env files (#20620) ## Description Publishing Docker Compose output into a directory containing a multiline quoted `.env` value currently drops continuation lines and the closing quote. The resulting file can no longer be parsed by Docker Compose. This preserves the complete raw quoted value, including its original line endings, escaped quotes, blank lines, and embedded `#`/`=` characters.
